description: Where your holdings stand against the US lines that bring a filing or cap concentration: more than 5% of a company's class (Schedule 13D or 13G), more than 10% (Section 16 insider), $100 million in 13(f) securities (Form 13F), and the 75-5-10 and RIC diversification tests; each position's share of its class from the last cover page and days to exit from FINRA's volume. A check, not compliance advice.

cash.description: Cash, receivables and US Government securities in US dollars: part of total assets, and qualifying in the diversification tests.

fund.description: true for an ETF or other investment company: the diversification tests count it as qualifying at any size.

price.description: Price per share in US dollars, when value is not given.

shares.description: Shares held (depositary shares for an ADR).

symbol.description: A US-listed ticker (AAPL, BRK.B) or a CIK.

value.description: Market value in US dollars. Without it or price, the latest price is read where this server has prices.

participation.description: The share of a day's volume you would sell into, for days to exit; default 0.2.

name: portfolio_rules

outputSchema.description: holdings rows are positions in the order of columns; lines say which positions cross each filing line; concentration and diversification need every position's value

title: Ownership lines, Form 13F and diversification
